title: F1-weighted-rubric case
description: A single evaluation case graded by f1_weighted_rubric over free-text management-plan action items. Each rubric item is one candidate action; its signed `points` encode both direction and severity and map to a 1–9 class (+3→9, +2→8, +1→7, 0→5, −1→3, −2→2, −3→1) before weighted precision/recall (weights 72/24/3/1). Appropriate actions are positive (+1 mild, +2 moderate, +3 severe importance-to-include), inappropriate actions are negative (−1 mild, −2 moderate, −3 severe harm-if-taken), and equivocal actions are 0.
